sources.title: Further allocation statutes: § 1 GemFinRefG (municipal share of income tax and withholding tax), § 7 ZerlG (wage-tax decomposition), § 1 GewStG/§ 16 (assessment), Art. 105 GG
sources.basis: Statute text in force at retrieval

files.description: § 1 GemFinRefG: municipalities receive 15 % of wage/assessed income tax and 12 % of the withholding tax
§ 7 ZerlG: wage tax decomposed to the Land of residence
Art. 105 GG: legislative competence incl. Länder rate-setting for real-estate transfer tax
§ 7 GemFinRefG: Berlin and Hamburg pay only the federal part of the trade-tax levy
§ 3 AO: legal definition of taxes (levies without an individual consideration) — basis for 'contributions are not taxes'
